name: Liao Shih-mei
bio: Liao Shih-mei (廖世美; Liao Shimei; 12th century) was a writer of ci, the Chinese song lyrics composed to set tunes, in the Song dynasty.
The single ci here is from the chinese-poetry dataset of Zhu Zumou's 1924 anthology Three Hundred Song Lyrics (宋词三百首), in simplified characters, with the tune name as title.

poems.title: 烛影摇红 (Zhu ying yao hong)
poems.author: Liao Shih-mei
poems.collection: 宋詞三百首 (Three Hundred Song Lyrics)
poems.text:
霭霭春空，画楼森耸凌云渚。
紫薇登览最关情，绝妙夸能赋。
惆怅相思迟暮。
记当日、朱阑共语。
塞鸿难问，岸柳何穷，别愁纷絮。
催促年光，旧来流水知何处。
断肠何必更残阳，极目伤平楚。
晚霁波声带雨。
悄无人、舟横野渡。
数峰江上，芳草天涯，参差烟树。
